controller_12m.notes: Verified. Re-derived independently: second-period clause located on the cited page, quote verbatim. Six months commencing on the date on which the first period expires (the six-month anniversary of the Listing Date) runs to the day before the 12-month anniversary, so first_free_day = 12-month anniversary. Second period is conditional on ceasing to be a Controlling Shareholder; recorded as the standard conditional 12m controller restriction. Date arithmetic re-checked in python. No 18C/18A references.
